name: Input
description: A single-line text input component. Integrates with FormControl context to receive id, required, disabled, and invalid state automatically. Supports optional leading and trailing element slots (icon, button, adornment) and three sizes.

notes: When used inside a FormControl, the input's id is set to the context id so the FormLabel's htmlFor links correctly.
aria-describedby is automatically built from '{id}-helper' and/or '{id}-error' when inside a FormControl.
aria-required is set when the FormControl is required.
aria-invalid is set when the FormControl is invalid.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus) and a 2px offset.
Minimum touch target for md and lg sizes meets the 44x44px requirement.
leftElement and rightElement are aria-hidden so decorative icons do not pollute the accessible name.

size.description: Controls the input height, padding, and font size. xs is a compact size for dense UIs. md and lg meet the 44px minimum touch target.

leftElement.description: An element (icon, text, etc.) placed in the leading slot of the input. The input receives additional inline-start padding to avoid text overlap.

rightElement.description: An element placed in the trailing slot. The input receives additional inline-end padding to avoid text overlap.

clearable.description: When true, shows a clear button (×) when the input has a value. Fires onChange with an empty value on clear.

positive.description: Shows a positive (success/valid) border style using color-border-success.

disabled.description: Disables the input. Also inherited from FormControl context if not explicitly set.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the outer wrapper div.

sizes.xs: min-block-size 24px — very compact, for dense UIs like data tables. Does not meet touch target.
sizes.sm: min-block-size 32px — suitable for dense UIs. Does not meet 44px touch target; avoid on touch-primary interfaces.
sizes.md: min-block-size 40px — default. Meets 44px touch target via min-inline-size and padding.
sizes.lg: min-block-size 48px — for prominent or standalone fields.

do: Always pair with a FormLabel (via FormControl) to provide an accessible name.
Use leftElement for leading icons that visually clarify the input purpose (e.g., search icon, currency symbol).
Use rightElement for trailing actions like show/hide password or clear buttons.
Use size='sm' only in dense UI contexts like data tables where 44px targets are not achievable.
dont: Do not place interactive elements in leftElement or rightElement without making them keyboard-accessible separately.
Do not use inline styles to adjust input appearance — add a token and use var(--token-name) in the CSS.
Do not omit a label — if a visible label is not possible, provide aria-label directly on the Input.
